notes.title: Major Update v0.4.0: Missions, Improvements, and More!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of v0.4, packed with new features, improvements, and fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what's new:

[h2]🆕 New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Missions Added:
[list]
[*] Start with Mission #1 - First Leap:
[list]
[*] Objective: Clear the Ruins domain of all enemies.
[*] Features: Night vision enabled, no revive allowed.
[*] Rewards: Top up to 50,000 points and advance to wave #50.
[/list][/list][/list][list][*] Weapon Type Rotation: Experience more variety with rotating weapon types during the first waves.
[/list]
[h2]🔧 Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] 60fps UI Cap: Ensures smoother performance and responsiveness for the user interface.
[*] Event Dispatcher for HUD: Replaced Interface with Event Dispatcher for cleaner communication.
[*] Item Data Table Optimization: Moved the call to the Game Instance BP Interface for better efficiency.
[*] Weapon Switching Improved: Now handled via an Interface for smoother gameplay.
[*] Enemy Skeletal Mesh: Enemies now spawn without a default material to prevent visual glitches.
[*] Dynamic Material Instances Removed: Guns and fireballs no longer use dynamic materials for performance optimization.
[/list]
[h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Edge Jumping: Fixed an issue where enemies would jump near edges unexpectedly.
[*] Enemy Stalling on Jump: Added movement impulse to ensure smoother enemy behavior when jumping.
[*] Pickup While Reloading: You can now pick up items again while reloading!
[*] Wave Aiming Restriction: Aiming is now disabled during wave completion to improve flow.
[/list]
[h2]⚡ Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] UI Enhancements: Removed color binding and introduced Invalidation Boxes for better performance.
[*] Removed Shadows: Shadows on enemy eyes have been removed for a cleaner look.
[*] Body Slot Materials Removed: Simplified material usage for better performance.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy the new features, smoother gameplay, and improved mechanics. Your feedback is invaluable, so keep it coming as we refine and expand the game!

[i]Happy gaming,
The Development Team[/i]

notes.title: Playtest v0.3.0 Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello, testers! We’re excited to share that Playtest v0.3.0 is live and ready for action! This version is a full copy of the previous v0.3.0 release, bringing back all its features and improvements—most notably the debut of our first-ever ability: [b]Rust Touch[/b].

[h3]New Feature: Rust Touch[/h3]
Harness the power of decay with [b]Rust Touch[/b], the first ability introduced in our game! This powerful new mechanic allows you to corrode metallic enemies at close range, transforming them into dust as they freeze in motion. Get up close and personal with foes to unleash this unique ability. Rust Touch not only expands your combat options but also encourages strategic thinking about positioning and timing.

Rust Touch can be activated by pressing the [b]Middle Mouse Button[/b] or [b]X[/b] on your Xbox controller.

[h3]Playtest Focus:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Test Rust Touch: [/b]Try out this new ability in combat and experiment with different strategies. We’d love your feedback on its effectiveness, balance, and usability.
[*] [b]Report Bugs & Share Insights: [/b]Your reports on any bugs, balance issues, or gameplay feedback are crucial to shaping the final experience.
[/list]
Jump in, test Rust Touch, and help us refine this exciting new mechanic. We can’t wait to hear your thoughts! 🌌

notes.title: Game Update 0.3.0: Unleash the Power of Rust Touch!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of [b]Version 0.3.0[/b], a significant update that introduces a brand new gameplay mechanic: [b]Rust Touch![/b] This major update enhances your combat experience and adds a new layer of strategy to your encounters.

[h3]What’s New in 0.3.0?[/h3]
[b]Introducing Rust Touch[/b]
Harness the power of decay with [b]Rust Touch[/b], the first ability introduced in our game! This powerful new mechanic allows you to corrode metallic enemies at close range, transforming them into dust as they freeze in motion. Get up close and personal with foes to unleash this unique ability. Rust Touch not only expands your combat options but also encourages strategic thinking about positioning and timing.

Rust Touch can be activated by pressing the [b]Middle Mouse Button[/b] or [b]X[/b] on your Xbox controller.

[h3]Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Mechanics:[/b] Experience a fresh way to engage with enemies and explore tactical approaches to battles.
[*] [b]Strategic Depth:[/b] Utilize Rust Touch effectively to maximize your effectiveness in combat and adapt your playstyle to different situations.
[*] [b]Visual and Audio Improvements:[/b] Enjoy new effects and sounds that bring the Rust Touch ability to life, immersing you in the experience.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing and Tweaking[/h3]
In this update, we’ve also taken the opportunity to balance existing mechanics and enemy behaviors, ensuring that the introduction of Rust Touch integrates smoothly into the gameplay. Expect a refined experience as we continue to polish and enhance the game.

[h3]Future Focus[/h3]
Moving forward, we plan to concentrate on expanding the ability system, introducing new powers that enhance gameplay depth. We will also continue to add more weapons and maps, ensuring they integrate seamlessly with the evolving abilities, enriching your overall experience.

[h3]Why Version 0.3.0?[/h3]
With the introduction of Rust Touch, the first ability in the game, we felt this update warranted a major version increase. Rust Touch marks a new phase in gameplay, adding depth and strategic options that redefine combat. We’re committed to delivering meaningful content that expands gameplay and enhances the single-player experience.

[h3]Join Us on This Journey![/h3]
As we roll out this major update, we’re excited for you to dive in and explore the new possibilities Rust Touch offers. Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we develop the game further!

[b]Stay tuned for more updates, and happy gaming![/b]

notes.title: v0.2.8 Update: Gravity Gun with Bent Time!
notes.content:
The Gravity Gun has arrived, bending time as you battle! This powerful new weapon lets you manipulate the speed of time in strange ways.

We’ve capped the time speed change at 300%—enough to give you a taste of this phenomenon, but still manageable for an unmodified human.

And this is just a tip of the iceberg of the alien technology we plan to bring to you!

notes.title: 🛠 Incoming Update: Version 0.2.8 – The Gravity Gun! 🛠
notes.content:
[b]A groundbreaking new weapon is in testing![/b]

Our latest creation, the [b]Gravity Gun[/b], harnesses the forces of gravity itself. Unlike its predecessors, this weapon needs [b]no ammunition[/b] and remains [b]cool under pressure[/b]—a clear advantage over the recently launched laser gun. Yet, its gravity manipulation comes at a cost: it has the potential to bend the very fabric of space-time!

Our engineers are working tirelessly to bring this incredible power safely into your hands, but controlling it has proven… challenging.

[h3]Stay tuned for v0.2.8 to wield the power of the universe with the Gravity Gun![/h3]

notes.title: v0.2.7 Gameplay Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Revive Mechanic Update: The revive location has changed from a predetermined spot to a random “safe” location. Reviving is an essential part of gameplay, allowing players to continue after being defeated by enemies. The number of revives is unlimited.

[*] Revive Penalty Adjustment: No revive penalty is applied for waves 1 through 5.

[*] Bug Fix: Previously, the revive function did not set the collision capsule correctly. This issue has now been fixed.

[*] Score Update: Negative scores are no longer calculated.

[*] Fireball Damage Adjustment: Fireball damage has been reduced for the first 10 waves to allow for a smoother start.

[*] New Enemy Appearance: Phantom robots now appear starting at Wave 3.

[*] Miscellaneous Fixes: Minor bug fixes have been implemented for issues found in the Achievements (v0.2.5) and Laser Gun (v0.2.6) updates.
[/list]

[*] 📊 Rifle Specs in Portal: View rifle specs directly in the Portal.
[*] 🌟 Portal Guide Light: New guide light added for easier navigation.
[*] 🗺️ Loading Indicator: "Loading..." indicator now shows when switching maps.
[*] 🔑 Portal Key Update: Access the Portal with the "E" key.
[*] 🕶️ Pistol Light Fix: Midnight mode now features a functional pistol light.
[*] 🔋 Ammo Count Resolved: Low ammo count bug is fixed.
[/list]
🔜 [b]Looking Ahead:[/b]

This update is just a glimpse of what’s to come in [b]v0.2[/b]! We’re working on exciting new features and improvements that we think you’ll love.

Thank you for your support! Stay tuned for more updates and the major [b]v0.2[/b] release.

notes.title: 🦋 Transition to v0.2: A New Era Begins! 🦋
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that in the next few weeks, we’re moving
[h3]from [b]v0.1[/b] to [b]v0.2[/b][/h3]
 - a major step forward for our game!

[b]v0.1[/b] has set the stage with foundational gameplay, and thanks to your feedback, we’re ready to expand and enhance the experience. We’re launching [b]v0.2[/b] to introduce new features and improvements that we hope you'll find exciting!

Stay tuned for more details and the official release date. Your continued support has been instrumental, and we’re excited to share the next chapter with you!

notes.title: v0.1.10 Update: The Portal Is Here! 🚀
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the arrival of The Portal in version v0.1.10! This brand-new feature brings an entirely new layer of control and customization to your gameplay experience.

[h2]What’s New:[/h2]

🔹 [b]The Portal Interface:[/b] Step into the Portal to manage core elements of your game. Within the Portal, you’ll be able to:
[list]
[*] [b]Select Game Modes 🕹️:[/b] Choose between Daylight and Midnight modes.
[*] [b]Choose Maps 🌍:[/b] Once new maps are available, you can select them here.
[*] [b]Adjust Weapon Settings 🔫:[/b] New weapons will unlock customization options in this menu.
[/list]
🔹 [b]Quick Access:[/b] Approach the Portal and press P to open it instantly, giving you seamless access to these controls during gameplay. When switching modes (or maps), the main game variables in the current wave are transferred to the new location—so no need to replay from the start of the wave.

Dive into the Portal and take control of your game like never before! We look forward to your feedback as we continue improving the experience.

Happy gaming! 💥

notes.title: v0.1.9 Update: Checkpoints!
notes.content:
We're excited to introduce a new checkpoint feature that remembers your highest wave! 🎉

Now, when you start a new session, you can choose to either begin fresh from Wave 1 or jump straight back to your highest wave reached. No more starting over—pick up right where you left off and conquer the next enemy waves!

Happy gaming, and as always, thank you for your continued support! 💥

notes.title: v0.1.8 Update: Enemy Waves & More
notes.content:
We've got some exciting updates for you!

[olist]
[*] [b]Wave-Based Gameplay:[/b] The game now features an unlimited number of enemy waves. It starts off easy, but each wave becomes more challenging, with faster, tougher robots that deal more damage.

[*] [b]One-Shot Headshots:[/b] You can now take down robots with a single bullet by landing a headshot!

[*] [b]Unified Modes:[/b] We've merged all modes except Midnight into one gameplay experience, featuring familiar robots from Casual, Intense, Ultimate, Marathon, Phantom, and Midnight modes.

[*] [b]New Maps:[/b] Midnight mode is getting its own map with a new landscape, and the unpublished Polar map is also in the works.

[*] [b]Survival Challenge:[/b] We've removed the ammo-to-kill ratio calculation. Now it's all about survival, with unlimited bullets. More weapons and accessories are planned.

[*] [b]Future Updates:[/b] We're planning to add checkpoints or save your highest wave, so you can start from where you left off.
[/olist]

Get ready for the ultimate challenge!

notes.title: v0.1.7 Update: Brighter Colors & Grass Terrain
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve got a fresh update for you! 🌟 We’ve brightened up the color scheme to make your gameplay experience more vibrant and immersive. Additionally, we’ve added some lush green grass to the ground, giving the environment a more lively and natural feel. 🌱

Jump in and check out the new look! As always, your feedback is invaluable, so let us know what you think!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: v0.1.6 Update: New Sky Graphics
notes.content:
[h3]Advanced Sky Graphics[/h3]

We’re excited to introduce new sky graphics in Midnight Mode, featuring a stunning starry sky and the mesmerizing aurora borealis. While currently exclusive to Midnight Mode, its elements will soon enhance other modes, including the upcoming [b]Polar Mode[/b]. Dive into Midnight Mode now to experience the beauty of the alien night!

notes.title: v0.1.5 Update: Midnight Mode
notes.content:
[h3]🌙 Midnight Mode is Here! 🌙[/h3]
Experience the thrill of the night in Alien Weapon Test Grounds with our new [b]Midnight Mode[/b]!

[h3]What’s New?[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Eternal Night:[/b] Battle in a dark, immersive night-time setting.
[*] [b]Accessory Lights:[/b] Enhanced visibility for normal and scoped aiming.[/list]
Dive into the fog and master the shadows!

We also added new Keypad controls to complete keyboard set up for left handed players. For details, visit our Steam Community page - Game Controls post.

We’d love to hear your feedback on Midnight Mode and the new controls. Your input is crucial as we work to refine and enhance the game.

notes.title: v0.1.4 Update: Phantom Mode & More
notes.content:
[h3]Phantom Mode[/h3]

Experience a new level of tension in [b]Phantom Mode[/b]. The robots have become stealthier, blending into the environment and making them incredibly hard to spot. You'll need sharp instincts and quick reactions to survive this challenge.

[h3]New Left-Handed Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]IJKL[/b] - Move
[*] [b]/[/b] or [b]Right Shift[/b] - Sprint
[*] [b]U[/b] - Reload[/list]
We’re excited to hear your thoughts on Phantom Mode and the new controls. Your feedback is essential as we continue to refine and improve the game.

[h3]Coming Soon: Midnight mode[/h3]

notes.title: v0.1.3 Update: Ultimate Mode
notes.content:
The Ultimate mode is nearly impossible to win:

[list][*] [b]Faster Robots:[/b] The robots are now faster. You can only outrun them using Sprint—don't forget that Sprint works when moving backwards as well.

[*] [b]Increased Danger:[/b] The robots are deadlier, so you'll need to use Medpacks frequently to survive.

[*] [b]More Robots:[/b] They are more numerous, and you'll have to rely on constant and precise shooting to keep their numbers in check.
[/list]

[b]Coming Soon:[/b] Phantom and Midnight modes

notes.title: v0.1.2 Game Update
notes.content:
[h3]v0.1.2 improvements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Left-Handed Mouse Settings:[/b] Swap the left and right mouse buttons for left-handed players.

[*] [b]Controller Rumble Support:[/b] Added rumble feedback for taking damage and firing.

[*] [b]Robots Steal Ammo and Medpacks:[/b] Robots now steal ammo boxes and first aid kits instead of running through them. Make sure to pick them up before the robots have a chance to take them.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.1.1: New Modes, Xbox Controller Support, and More!
notes.content:
We’re excited to share the latest update for Alien Weapon Test Grounds! Here’s what’s new in Early Access Version: Alpha v0.1.1:

[h3]New Gameplay Modes:[/h3]

[list][*] [b]Difficult Mode:[/b] Face off against more robots and increased damage.

[*] [b]Marathon Mode:[/b] Enjoy the original pace with a massive 10,000 robots and 15,000 ammo.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

[list][*] [b]Optimization:[/b] Reduced complexity in shaders and lighting for improved performance.

[*] [b]Gameplay Tweaks:[/b]

[list][*] Increased starting ammo.
[*] Added "No Ammo" warning.[/list]
[*] [b]Mouse Sensitivity:[/b] You can now adjust mouse sensitivity in the Settings menu. Press [b]'Esc'[/b], then navigate to [b]'Settings'[/b] to customize it to your preference.

[*] [b]Xbox Controller Support:[/b] You can now use an Xbox gamepad to play the game and set its look sensitivity from 0.2 to 1.5. Press [b]'Left Bumper (LB)'[/b] and use [b]'D-Pad Up / Down'[/b] to change the sensitivity to your preference.

[list][*] [b]Xbox controls:[/b]

[list][*] [b]Left Stick (LS):[/b] Move
[*] [b]LS Press:[/b] Sprint
[*] [b]Right Stick (RS):[/b] Look
[*] [b]RS Press:[/b] 180-degree Turn
[*] [b]Right Trigger (RT):[/b] Automatic Fire
[*] [b]Right Bumper (RB):[/b] Single Fire
[*] [b]Left Trigger (LT):[/b] Start Aiming / Stop Aiming
[*] [b]A:[/b] Jump
[*] [b]X:[/b] Manual Reload
[*] [b]D-Pad Left / Right:[/b] Equipment selection
[*] [b]D-Pad Up:[/b] Hold to adjust look sensitivity by 1.5x
[*] [b]D-Pad Down:[/b] Hold to adjust look sensitivity by 0.5x
[*] [b]Left Bumper (LB) + D-Pad Up / Down:[/b] Set look sensitivity
[*] [b]Start & Back Buttons:[/b] Exit Menu
[*] When in Menus:

[list][*] [b]Left Stick (LS) Up/Down:[/b] Navigate menu
[*] [b]D-Pad Up/Down: [/b]Navigate menu
[*] [b]A:[/b] Select
[/list][/list][/list][/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]

Fixed the "safe" location cheat on the platform edges.
For bug reporting, visit [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3123080/discussions/0/4520009742921101962/]Bug Reporting and Known Issues[/url].

[h3]Coming Soon:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Insane Mode:[/b] Stay tuned for our most challenging mode yet!
[/list]
[b]Important:[/b] We’re actively working on vibration support and fine-tuning settings for Xbox controllers. Your feedback is invaluable! Please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3123080/discussions/0/4520009742920756793/]Game Controls page[/url] for detailed controls and settings.

Thank you for your continued support, and enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Alien Weapon Test Grounds Now Available!
notes.content:
[h3]Introduction[/h3]

We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest game, Alien Weapon Test Grounds, in Early Access! Prepare yourself for an exhilarating adventure in a futuristic extradimensional arena where you'll test our newly discovered alien weaponry.

[b]Early Access Version:[/b] Alpha v0.1.0

[h3]Key Features[/h3]

[list][*] [b]Intense Arena Battles:[/b] Engage in high-octane battles against aggressive robots. Accessible for newcomers, with more challenging modes like Difficult and Insane planned for future updates. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3123080/discussions/0/4520009742920668558/]See our Development Plans[/url] for more details.
[*] [b]Unusual Arsenal:[/b] Test unique and powerful alien weapons.
[*] [b]Immersive Gameplay:[/b] Experience basic recoil, a functional scope, and a captivating first-person perspective.
[*] [b]Solo Campaign:[/b] Embark on a challenging single-player journey through the proving grounds.
[*] [b]High-Quality Graphics:[/b] Enjoy stunning 3D visuals and detailed environments.
[*] [b]Dynamic Controls:[/b] Utilize intuitive controls for precise aiming and movement.
[/list]
[h3]Game Details[/h3]

[list][*] [b]Title:[/b] Alien Weapon Test Grounds
[*] [b]Genre:[/b] First-Person Shooter (FPS)
[*] [b]Mode:[/b] Single Player
[*] [b]Platform:[/b] Windows
[*] [b]Controllers:[/b] Mouse and Keyboard (Xbox Controller support planned). See [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3123080/discussions/0/4520009742920756793/]Game Controls page[/url] for details.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Story[/h3]

As requested by the customers of our alien weapon service center, we have created a firing test site located in an extradimensional domain featuring authentic ancient ruins. You will receive one of the available rifles with 1,500 rounds, and we will deploy 1,000 unarmed but aggressive bots for you to test your weapon on. Keep an eye on the ammo-to-kill ratio; it should not exceed 1.5 to ensure you can complete the level.

Additionally, you'll receive a combustion handgun with 200 rounds for further testing. Both weapons are designed with realistic recoil and bullet spread, ensuring an authentic and challenging experience. Immerse yourself in this unique testing environment and assess the true potential of our alien weaponry.

[h3]Special Launch Offer[/h3]

[b]Limited-Time Discount:[/b] Get Alien Weapon Test Grounds at 40% off for the first 14 days after launch!

[h3]Support and Feedback[/h3]

As Alien Weapon Test Grounds launches in Early Access, we value your input to help shape the game to meet your expectations. Please use the links below to share your feedback and report any issues, and we'll do our best to enhance the game for your enjoyment.

For suggestions, bug reporting, and details on game controls and our development plans, please visit the game’s Community Hub:
